long_biography.plain_text:
The 1987 sale of Nabila for $30 million established Jonathan Beckett among the leading figures in large-yacht brokerage. The transaction doubled the previous record. It followed sparse beginnings: a commission-only post in Greece, a tiny London office and a long wait before his first yacht sale.

After founder Nigel Burgess died during the Vendée Globe, Beckett took responsibility for the firm and widened its model beyond sales. Burgess added charter, technical, management and new-construction teams, opened offices across several continents and built long client relationships around discreet advice. Beckett still works on brokerage and build projects while directing the company's expansion in the Americas from Miami.

uncertainties.detail: Jonathan Beckett is a common name, but the saved owner record itself names Burgess as his employer. That link matches the current company profile, and Companies House supplies the full name Jonathan William Field Beckett for Burgess's active director. Unrelated people with the same short name have no matching employer, industry or career chronology and are excluded.

Beckett acquired a controlling stake in the 1990s and was still reported as an individual person with significant control in 2023. Official filings show that his significant-control status ceased on 1 November 2025 when a corporate shareholder assumed control. Current company material nevertheless retains him as managing partner and chief executive, so Operator is used without implying present majority ownership.

The current Burgess profile explicitly says Beckett moved to Miami in August 2024 and now resides there. Companies House still lists Monaco for his long-running directorship, while a separate 2023 control filing listed the United Kingdom. The later first-party residential statement supports United States as the main residence, but the conflicting administrative entries keep confidence below 100.

Companies House securely establishes June 1957 but not an exact birth day or birthplace. Biographical directories make more specific claims without adequate primary or high-quality independent support, so no birth-day, place-of-birth or birth-country proposal is made.
